highlights.title: Save and share pictures
highlights.line: Hold a picture in a chat, or open it: Save puts it in your photos, Share sends it on.

highlights.title: Brain keeps watch for you
highlights.line: Ask Brain to watch a build or a page: it checks quietly and acts when it changes.

try.target: Tell me when the nightly build on main goes red

highlights.title: Rename, move or merge Work
highlights.line: Open a Work and tap ⋯ to rename it, move it to a project or merge it with another.

fixes: Screen shows the agent's window as live video, and the picture keeps moving on a weak link.
Stop also ends the commands the agent's turn started.
Finished Work closes itself, and the tray is one list of your Work.
Brain can ask you something while a Worker still holds the Work.
A long press on a hostname, link or path in a reply selects it whole.
Phone use types at the cursor like a keyboard, so an app's # and @ pickers open.
A Chinese input method types what you meant on Screen and in the web terminal.
